products.title: Sunday 4.0
products.body_html:
I apologize to all that were unable to get a bag in the the latest production run of Sunday 4.0 bags, released on 9/30.  They, incredibly, sold out in minutes.  The next production run of Sunday 4.0 bags (navy, honey, black, rosemary, forest green) will be available towards the middle of November.  Once again, thank you for your amazing support!

 

Features:

  • Perfectly balanced shoulder straps for the most comfortable carry you have ever experienced
  • Removable straps for back-pack or single strap carrying options
  • UV resistant and waterproof canvas fabric, typically used in the marine industry
  • Hard plastic bottom for improved durability
  • Premium leather trim
  • 4-way divider, 7-inch diameter top, 8-inch diameter base
  • Comfortably fits 14 clubs, but if you have larger grips or are sensitive to grip tangle, 12 may be better
  • Water bottle sleeve
  • Umbrella holder
  • Rain hood included
  • Carbon fiber stand legs with custom hickory wraps courtesy of Caddy Wrap
  • lightweight, minimalist design. Bag - 4 lbs 3 oz; Straps - 6 oz each

products.title: Rangefinder Case
products.body_html: In collaboration with Bluegrass Fairway, we have created a limited run of rangefinder cases to perfectly compliment to your Shapland 3.1 model bag.  The brown wool Harris Tweed herringbone and brown waxed canvas backed rangefinder case has a magnetic flap closure to keep your equipment both secure and stylish.

products.title: Driver Head Cover - Sunfish Sailing Series
products.body_html: Made in collaboration with the talented team over at Jan Craig headcovers, these custom designed 460cc worsted wool headcovers with tassels are hand knit in the USA with all designs matching some of Sunfish Sailing's most iconic sail patterns.

products.title: Replacement stand legs - Carbon Fiber
products.body_html:
These come as a set of two legs, left and right, and are ONLY compatible with Shapland golf bags.

Warranty: If you purchased your bag less than 2 years ago and a leg broke, send us a note and we can get you a replacement set for free.
